name: Carrot Salad Lettuce Wraps with Hard-Boiled Eggs, Mayo & Capers

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a large pot, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
9 medium carrots
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp honey
2 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Peel and halve the eggs. Season with salt.
Place mayo, water, and additional salt in a small bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp water
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with carrot salad and eggs. Spoon mayo sauce over eggs, top with capers, and season with pepper. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp capers
½ tsp black pepper
